# statuspal-next_monitoring_check (Resource)

Manages an uptime monitoring check (HTTP or TCP). Optionally drives status-page incident automation: set the `automation` block to link the check to a status-page service so that going down automatically opens an incident and recovering resolves it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A simple HTTP uptime check.
resource "statuspal-next_monitoring_check" "api" {
  name              = "API Gateway health"
  url               = "https://api.acme.com/health"
  http_method       = "get"
  recv_timeout_secs = 5
  geo_areas         = ["US", "EU"]
  recipient_emails  = ["ops@acme.com"]
}

# A TCP check that also drives status-page incident automation: when it goes
# down, an incident is opened on the "api" service in the "eu" container, and
# resolved when it recovers.
resource "statuspal-next_monitoring_check" "db" {
  name             = "Primary database"
  url              = "tcp://db.acme.com:5432"
  recipient_emails = ["ops@acme.com"]

  automation = {
    status_page_subdomain = "acme-status"
    container_slug        = "eu"
    service_slug          = "api"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the check.
- `recipient_emails` (Set of String) Emails of organization users to notify on status changes. At least one required.
- `url` (String) Full target URL. The scheme selects the check type: `tcp://host:port` is a TCP check; `http://` or `https://` is an HTTP check.

### Optional

- `automation` (Attributes) Links the check to a status-page service for incident automation. Omit to disable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automation))
- `display_response_time_chart` (Boolean) Whether to show a response-time chart on the status page.
- `geo_areas` (Set of String) Regions to monitor from (`US`, `EU`). Empty means all regions.
- `http_method` (String) HTTP method for HTTP checks. Ignored for TCP checks (do not set it on a `tcp://` check). One of: get, head, post, put, delete, patch, options.
- `recv_timeout_secs` (Number) Response timeout in seconds. One of: 1, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60.

### Read-Only

- `check_type` (String) Check type derived from `url` (`http` or `tcp`).
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp at which the check was created.
- `id` (String) TypeID-prefixed identifier (e.g. `mck_…`).
- `status` (String) Last status reported by the monitoring service (e.g. `up`, `down`); null until verified.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp at which the check was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--automation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `automation`

Required:

- `container_slug` (String) Slug of the container (region) holding the target service.
- `service_slug` (String) Slug of the service whose status this check updates.
- `status_page_subdomain` (String) Subdomain of the status page whose service this check drives.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Monitoring checks are imported by their TypeID.
terraform import statuspal-next_monitoring_check.api mck_01hxyzabcdefghijklmnopqr
```
